title: Filter movement and FX
goal: Make the bass filter breathe and send the lead into a tempo-synced delay.
explain: Signals like sine and saw are continuous patterns from 0 to 1; .range(400, 1800) scales them and .slow(8) stretches one sweep over 8 bars. Put a signal into lpf and the filter moves on its own, which is most of what makes a loop feel alive. lpq adds resonance at the cutoff. delay sets the send amount, delaytime is in seconds (0.35 is close to a dotted 8th at 128 bpm) and delayfeedback sets how many repeats you hear.
try_prompt: Make the bass filter sweep slowly over 8 bars with some resonance, and put a dotted-8th delay on the lead.
